description: This file implements functions for translating embedded HTML blocks within Markdown documents, utilizing the Goldmark Markdown parser and HTML tokenizer. It processes the document AST, identifies HTML blocks, and applies translation to HTML text nodes while skipping certain tags like <code>, <pre>, <script>, and <style>.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlocks
methods.description: Main function that processes Markdown content, finds HTML blocks, and replaces them with translated content using provided translator.

methods.name: htmlBlockSpan
methods.description: Determines the start and stop positions within the source for a given HTML block node.

methods.name: applyHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Applies a list of text replacements to the original HTML body, returning the modified string.

methods.name: sortHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Sorts replacements in order of their start positions to ensure correct application.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlock
methods.description: Translates the textual content within an HTML snippet while respecting tags to skip.

methods.name: shouldTranslateHTMLText
methods.description: Determines whether the given HTML text node should be translated based on its content and current depth of skipping tags.

methods.name: isSkipTag
methods.description: Checks if a tag is among those that should be skipped during translation.
